# A fish 0.7 m long (glTF facing +Z): body, tail, dorsal fin, eyes. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Body --base-color 1.000 0.878 0.494 --no-slot
material new Fin --base-color 0.933 0.416 0.486 --no-slot
material new Eye --base-color 0.451 0.275 0.298 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name Body --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.5 --location 0 0 0
scale 0.168 0.546 0.294
apply --scale
material assign Body
add mesh cone --name Tail --vertices 4 --radius1 0.162 --radius2 0.02 --depth 0.224 --location 0 0.329 0 --rotation -90 45 0
scale 1 1 1
material assign Fin
add mesh cone --name Dorsal --vertices 4 --radius1 0.112 --radius2 0.01 --depth 0.132 --location 0 0.035 0.162 --rotation 0 0 45
scale 0.35 1.4 1
material assign Fin
add mesh cube --name EyeL --size 0.070 --location 0.071 -0.182 0.024
material assign Eye
add mesh cube --name EyeR --size 0.070 --location -0.071 -0.182 0.024
material assign Eye
select all
shade flat
export fish_s.glb
